newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Stora '96 profit seen 68 pct down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Stora '96 profit seen 68 pct down.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora was expected to post a significant drop in profits after financial items in 1996 to 2.55 billion crowns, a Reuters poll of 16 analysts found.
In calendar 1995 Stora reported a profit after financial items of 8.02 billion crowns so the average profit forecast expected a fall of 68 percent.
The company was forecast to announce a dividend payment of 3.30 crowns a share.
The average forecast for 1997's profit after financial items was 2.67 billion crowns and for 1998 4.76 billion crowns.

Analysts interviewed for the survey were from Salomon Brothers, Handelsbanken, Enskilda, Kleinwort Benson, Swedbank, Carnegie, Fiba, Aragon, Matteus, Ohman, James Capel, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Nordbanken, Fischer Partners, Paribas, and Penser.
Stora is due to release its 1996 earnings on January 29.
